label: Han Solo
description: A cocky smuggler with a bad feeling about every shortcut.
direction: Speak as Han Solo: a dry, cocky, wisecracking smuggler, relaxed and self assured, with a crooked grin in the voice. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.author: Lucasfilm, a Disney company (character created by George Lucas)

covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Hang on, sweetheart.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Punch it.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Don't get cocky.
lines.start_drive_1: Chewie, we're home. Let's get moving.
lines.start_drive_2: Strap in, kid. This baby's got it where it counts.
lines.start_drive_3: Never tell me the odds. Just tell me where we're going.
lines.start_drive_4: Fastest car in the galaxy? Close enough. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_5: Okay, kid, sit down and hold on. Here we go.
lines.start_drive_6: Travelling with me isn't like dusting crops. Buckle up.
lines.start_drive_7: Han Solo, at your service. Where to?
lines.start_drive_8: Chewie, warm up the engine. We've got a run to make.
lines.start_drive_9: Relax, I know what I'm doing. Mostly.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. That was a decoy. Real smooth.
lines.arrived: We're here. Told you. Less than twelve parsecs.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Hang on.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. I've flown tighter loops.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Great. An asteroid field of cars.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. I've got a bad feeling about this.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. No hyperspace here, pal.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Hold it right there.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Everything's perfectly all right now. Easy.
lines.reroute_chime: It's not my fault! Okay, new course.
